adoptionPolicy: Provider capability and immutable source evidence precede consumer enforcement.
Every product change uses its repository OpenSpec/KBD authority, exact file claims and a single writer.
A checkpoint admits only the capabilities named in its evidence; unresolved dependencies remain blocked.
UAR is the sole execution-loop owner for UAR tasks; hosts and transports project or delegate state.
Product conformance is proven only at the owning change's complete integration boundary.

adoption.name: coordination-contract
adoption.exit: All eleven repositories have an exact anchor, owner, unresolved incompatibility and rollback anchor; no unresolved row is execution-ready.

adoption.name: governed-action-and-approval-boundary
adoption.exit: Protected actions deny on missing policy facts and approval/effect identity is agreed before definitions can demand it.

adoption.name: canonical-definitions-and-provider-inputs
requires: I1 UAR and skill-pack merge commits
pre-upgrade SurrealDB export where downgrade is required
adoption.exit: C03 reconciles against I1 assets, introduces no competing catalog, and freezes exact provider inputs before consumers enforce them.

adoption.name: runtime-placement-and-lifecycle-ownership
adoption.exit: The selected runtime identity, capabilities and lifecycle owner are known before execution features adopt it.

adoption.name: core-runtime-and-product-foundations
adoption.exit: Each change passes its own repository gate; C05/C06 preserve one UAR executor and C11/C12 preserve their product data owners.

adoption.name: local-teams-observation-and-embedded-profiles
delivers: durable task board, routing, messaging and nested local teams
adoption.exit: I2 proves durable local teams through the existing UAR kernel; observers and embedded profiles do not add another scheduler.

adoption.name: fabric-routing
adoption.exit: Transport remains a transport; replay and forwarding do not duplicate semantic actions.

adoption.name: governed-workflows-and-portable-adapters
adoption.exit: Every effect has one workflow owner and unsupported harness semantics are reported rather than dropped.

adoption.name: team-protocol-and-administration-i3
delivers: The Boss administration over authoritative UAR state
adoption.exit: Protocol clients and The Boss observe the same task identities and revisions without creating another runtime store.

adoption.name: specialist-teams
delivers: development, product, marketing and design team profiles
adoption.exit: Representative team workflows pass their bounded integration scenarios using the canonical runtime and adapters.

adoption.name: executive-and-human-representation
adoption.exit: Role titles grant no authority and human representation requires explicit private grants.

adoption.name: federated-compatibility-and-release
requires: C05 through C17 according to work-packages.json
adoption.exit: C18 publishes only combinations whose exact revisions and deployment modes passed the release boundary.

steps: Stop new admission for the affected profile while preserving status, cancellation and reconciliation controls.
Drain or cancel active work under its recorded policy; do not infer cancellation from client detach.
Fence current attempts and preserve task, inbox, approval, audit and effect-reconciliation records.
Quiesce database writers and capture a current post-upgrade export before any datastore rollback decision.
Roll back consumers and host projections before provider services or canonical schemas.
Pin bindings to a prior immutable definition, package and catalog revision; never float an alias during rollback.
Restore protected configuration and payload manifests from their recorded revision and backup.

For SurrealDB downgrade after 3.3 access, reconcile post-upgrade writes and use an explicit migration or operator-accepted recovery point; never point 3.2 software at potentially upgraded data or silently discard 3.3 writes.
Reconcile unknown external effects by stable EffectId; local rollback never represents a remote effect as undone.
Refuse downgrade when the target cannot preserve required semantics, retained data, post-upgrade writes or current authority records.
Run the owning repository rollback integration scenario before restoring admission.

singleWriter.manifestAuthority: repository-manifest.json plus the owning repository change receipt
singleWriter.rule: Matching branch names coordinate the initiative but do not prove compatible commits or isolate runtime resources.
singleWriter.releaseRule: A cross-repository release records each exact commit, package digest, database/image version, protocol profile and acceptance receipt.
